title: Mold Remediation Work-Plan Walk Hours by Mapped Water Footprint
content:
Supervisor's guide, Mold Remediation work plans: the work-plan walk covers the floor area the linked Water Damage Mitigation job mapped as affected, judged as that water job's records stood on the mold job's opened date, the day of the visit.

**Walk hours.**

- An affected area above the large footprint threshold of 300 square feet takes the quotient of 300 divided by the walk rate of 100 square feet per hour, which is 3 hours, to which the footprint step hours of 0.5 are added for each full or partial footprint step of 100 square feet of affected area above 300.
- An affected area above the mid footprint threshold of 150 square feet and at most 300 square feet takes the larger of two figures: the base visit hours of 2, and the quotient of the affected area divided by the walk rate of 100 square feet per hour.
- With no linked water job, or an affected area of at most 150 square feet, the walk takes the base visit hours of 2.

**Steps above 300 square feet.** The area above 300 square feet is divided into steps of 100 square feet and any part step counts as a whole step, so 1 to 100 square feet above the threshold is one step, 101 to 200 is two.

| Mapped affected area (hypothetical) | Walk hours |
|---|---|
| None, or no linked water job | 2 |
| 150 sq ft | 2 |
| 180 sq ft | 2 (180 divided by 100 is 1.8, below 2) |
| 265 sq ft | 2.65 |
| 300 sq ft | 3 |
| 301 sq ft | 3.5 (3 plus one step) |
| 520 sq ft | 4.5 (3 plus three steps of 0.5) |
